Author: M. S. Raman

entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Mr. Amitav Das, Advocate
 Coram:
 The Chief Justice
 Justice M. S. Raman
 Order

The Petitioner is aggrieved by an order dated 2nd November 2011 issued by the Commissioner of Endowments, Bhubaneswar appointing the Inspector of Endowments, Puri-I as Interim Trustee of the Petitioner-Temple.
2. The grievance of the Petitioner is that the land acquisition compensation payable to the Petitioner has been, by the said impugned order, prevented from being handed over to the Petitioner.

3. The stand taken by the Land Acquisition Officer, NH-203 is that in view of the aforementioned order dated 2nd November, 2011 compensation can be paid only to the Interim Trustee i.e. the Inspector of Endowments and not the Petitioner.

4. Attention of the Court has been drawn to Section 41 of the Orissa Hindu Religious Endowments Act, 1951 (OHRE Act) in terms of which the disputes as to whether the institution is a public institution or a religious institution has to be decided in the first instance by the Assistant Commissioner of Endowments.

entities.text: Orissa Hindu Religious Endowments Act, 1951 (OHRE Act)
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 5. It is pointed out that unless the Petitioner is able to produce the documents to show that it is a private temple, it will be presumed to be a public institution/temple and the OHRE Act would apply.

6. Therefore the Petitioner is at liberty to approach the Assistant Commissioner of Endowments and Shri Gopinath Dev Bije Puba Sasan vs The Competent Authority And Land .... ... on 17 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31477904/

Till such determination, no direction can be issued to the Opposite Party No.1 to pay the land acquisition compensation to the Petitioner.
7. The writ petition is accordingly disposed of in the above terms.
